title: HabitatShift: a reproducible, audited pipeline for Sentinel-1/2 change analysis
description: Open research platform for measuring candidate surface changes between two dates from Sentinel-2 optical and Sentinel-1 radar imagery, with independent audit scripts, noise-aware change tests, foundation-model change scores and a radar glacial-lake water model. Includes the technical report (docs/paper) and the version 3 paper source (docs/paper/v3).
